## 1. Repo Structure

Monorepo using pnpm workspaces + Turborepo.

```
bloodhound/
├── apps/
│   ├── web/               # Next.js 15 App Router frontend (TypeScript)
│   └── api/               # FastAPI (Python 3.12) AI + analytics backend
├── packages/
│   ├── ui/                # Shared shadcn/ui component library
│   ├── db/                # Drizzle schema + Supabase migrations
│   └── types/             # Shared TypeScript types + Zod schemas
├── docs/                  # Internal sprint/PRD docs (this folder) + public API docs
├── indexer/               # Future: custom Geyser indexer
├── .env.example
├── turbo.json
└── README.md
```

> **Note on docs format (Q72 — owner clarified):** Internal project docs live here as sprint PRDs with user stories and test cases — so AI agents never lose context. These update with every sprint. The public-facing API reference (for third-party developers) is a separate Mintlify site.

## 4. Database Architecture

### 4.1 Supabase (PostgreSQL) — Operational Data

**users** (managed by Clerk, synced on first sign-in)
```sql
CREATE TABLE users (
  id            uuid PRIMARY KEY,           -- Clerk user ID
  email         text UNIQUE,
  display_name  text,
  twitter_handle text,                      -- linked X/Twitter handle
  tier          text DEFAULT 'free',        -- 'free' | 'pro' | 'enterprise'
  created_at    timestamptz DEFAULT now()
);
```

**tracked_wallets**
```sql
CREATE TABLE tracked_wallets (
  id          uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  user_id     uuid REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  address     text NOT NULL,
  label       text NOT NULL,
  group_id    uuid REFERENCES wallet_groups(id),
  is_own      boolean DEFAULT false,        -- user's own wallet (private unless submitted)
  tags        text[],
  created_at  timestamptz DEFAULT now(),
  UNIQUE(user_id, address)
);
```

**wallet_groups**
```sql
CREATE TABLE wallet_groups (
  id          uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  user_id     uuid REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  name        text NOT NULL,
  created_at  timestamptz DEFAULT now()
);
-- Free tier: 1 group max (enforced in API). Pro: unlimited.
```

**known_wallets** (community-submitted, dev-approved)
```sql
CREATE TABLE known_wallets (
  id              uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  address         text UNIQUE NOT NULL,
  label           text NOT NULL,
  category        text NOT NULL,     -- see categories below
  description     text,
  twitter_handle  text,              -- main identifier per owner preference
  telegram_handle text,
  confidence      float DEFAULT 1.0,
  submitted_by    uuid REFERENCES users(id),
  approved_by     uuid REFERENCES users(id),
  approved_at     timestamptz,
  status          text DEFAULT 'pending',  -- 'pending' | 'approved' | 'rejected'
  version         integer DEFAULT 1,
  created_at      timestamptz DEFAULT now()
);

-- Categories (Q47, confirmed): kol | known_figure | profitable_trader |
--   protocol_team | exchange | suspected_bad_actor
```

**known_wallet_history** (version tracking, Q46)
```sql
CREATE TABLE known_wallet_history (
  id          uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  wallet_id   uuid REFERENCES known_wallets(id),
  label       text,
  category    text,
  description text,
  changed_by  uuid REFERENCES users(id),
  changed_at  timestamptz DEFAULT now()
);
```

**known_wallet_submissions**
```sql
CREATE TABLE known_wallet_submissions (
  id              uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  address         text NOT NULL,
  label           text NOT NULL,
  category        text NOT NULL,
  evidence_text   text,
  evidence_urls   text[],          -- Supabase Storage paths (PNG/JPG, max 10MB each)
  twitter_handle  text,
  telegram_handle text,
  submitter_id    uuid REFERENCES users(id),
  status          text DEFAULT 'pending',
  reviewer_note   text,
  created_at      timestamptz DEFAULT now()
);
-- Q43: Registered users only can submit. Q45: Dev team reviews only.
```

**side_wallet_candidates** (computed, user-disputable)
```sql
CREATE TABLE side_wallet_candidates (
  id              uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  wallet_a        text NOT NULL,
  wallet_b        text NOT NULL,
  confidence      float NOT NULL,
  signals         jsonb NOT NULL,      -- array of signal names that triggered flag
  signal_weights  jsonb NOT NULL,      -- {signal_name: weight} breakdown
  user_votes      jsonb DEFAULT '{}',  -- {user_id: 'confirm'|'dispute'}
  community_score float DEFAULT 0.5,
  computed_at     timestamptz DEFAULT now(),
  UNIQUE(wallet_a, wallet_b)
);
```

**wallet_classifications** (cached AI classification output)
```sql
CREATE TABLE wallet_classifications (
  address     text PRIMARY KEY,
  labels      text[],        -- ['whale_wallet', 'smart_money', 'deployer']
  confidence  jsonb,         -- {'whale_wallet': 0.95, 'smart_money': 0.78}
  signals     jsonb,         -- raw signals that triggered each label
  computed_at timestamptz DEFAULT now(),
  expires_at  timestamptz    -- recompute after this timestamp
);
```

**alerts**
```sql
CREATE TABLE alerts (
  id              uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  user_id         uuid REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  wallet_address  text NOT NULL,
  alert_type      text NOT NULL,
  -- types: 'any_tx' | 'sends_to' | 'receives_from' | 'token_trade' | 'balance_threshold' | 'inter_tracked'
  conditions      jsonb NOT NULL,
  delivery        text[] DEFAULT ARRAY['in_app'],
  -- delivery: 'in_app' | 'email' | 'push' | 'telegram' | 'webhook'
  is_active       boolean DEFAULT true,
  created_at      timestamptz DEFAULT now()
);
-- Q63: All alert condition types confirmed. Q64: All delivery channels confirmed.
-- Free tier: max 5 active alerts. Pro: unlimited.
-- Telegram + Webhook = Pro only.
```

**notifications**
```sql
CREATE TABLE notifications (
  id          uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  user_id     uuid REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  type        text NOT NULL,
  content     jsonb NOT NULL,
  is_read     boolean DEFAULT false,
  created_at  timestamptz DEFAULT now()
);
```

**wallet_embeddings** (pgvector — behavioral similarity search)
```sql
CREATE TABLE wallet_embeddings (
  address     text PRIMARY KEY,
  embedding   vector(1536),
  model       text DEFAULT 'voyage-large-2',
  updated_at  timestamptz DEFAULT now()
);
```

### 4.2 ClickHouse — Analytical Data

`[PLAN]` Start on ClickHouse Cloud free tier. Migrate to self-hosted Hetzner AX41-NVMe (~$40/mo) once cloud costs exceed $30/mo.

**transactions** (primary analytical table)
```sql
CREATE TABLE transactions (
  signature       String,
  block_time      DateTime,
  slot            UInt64,
  chain           String DEFAULT 'solana',  -- multi-chain ready per Q84
  signers         Array(String),
  fee             UInt64,
  tx_type         String,        -- 'SWAP' | 'TRANSFER' | 'NFT_SALE' | 'MINT' | 'BURN' | 'STAKE' etc.
  source_platform String,        -- 'axiom' | 'phantom' | 'jupiter' | 'raydium' | 'pump_fun' | 'coinbase' | 'orca' | 'jito' | 'unknown'
  source_program  String,        -- program address
  status          String,        -- 'success' | 'failed'
  raw_events      String         -- JSON blob of Helius parsed events
) ENGINE = MergeTree()
PARTITION BY toYYYYMM(block_time)
ORDER BY (block_time, signature);
```

Note: `source_platform` is the human-readable platform name (used for transaction source logos in UI). Derived from Helius enriched data + source program address matching.

**transfers** (extracted from transactions)
```sql
CREATE TABLE transfers (
  tx_signature    String,
  block_time      DateTime,
  from_address    String,
  to_address      String,
  token_mint      String,    -- 'SOL' for native SOL transfers
  amount          Float64,
  amount_usd      Float64,   -- at time of tx; 0 if unknown
  chain           String DEFAULT 'solana'
) ENGINE = MergeTree()
PARTITION BY toYYYYMM(block_time)
ORDER BY (from_address, block_time);
```

**token_trades** (DEX swap events)
```sql
CREATE TABLE token_trades (
  tx_signature    String,
  block_time      DateTime,
  trader          String,
  dex             String,        -- 'raydium' | 'orca' | 'pump_fun' | 'meteora' | 'jupiter_agg'
  token_in_mint   String,
  token_out_mint  String,
  amount_in       Float64,
  amount_out      Float64,
  amount_usd      Float64,
  realized_pnl_usd Float64,     -- calculated where possible
  chain           String DEFAULT 'solana'
) ENGINE = MergeTree()
PARTITION BY toYYYYMM(block_time)
ORDER BY (trader, block_time);
```

**wallet_stats_daily** (materialized view)
```sql
CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW wallet_stats_daily
ENGINE = SummingMergeTree()
PARTITION BY toYYYYMM(date)
ORDER BY (address, date)
AS SELECT
  from_address    AS address,
  toDate(block_time) AS date,
  count()         AS tx_count,
  sum(amount_usd) AS volume_usd
FROM transfers
GROUP BY address, date;
```

**Bloodhound AI:**


## 6. Wallet Classification Engine

### 6.1 Classification Labels

All thresholds are configurable via environment variables — do not hardcode.

**WHALE WALLET** (Q25 — dynamic, factors in real liquidity and transaction volume)
- Condition A: Portfolio USD value ≥ $50,000 (real liquidity if sold)
- Condition B: Total SOL moved (rolling 30 days) ≥ 2,000 SOL
- Condition C: Current SOL balance ≥ 500 SOL
- Confidence: 0.90 if A, 0.80 if B only, 0.75 if C only
- Dynamic: relative to token context when displayed on a token page

**WHALE HOLDER** (Q25 — distinct from Whale Wallet)
- Holds ≥ 1% of a specific token's total supply
- Token-specific label, shown on that token's holder list
- Confidence: 1.0 (deterministic — on-chain supply data)

**SMART MONEY** (Q27)
- Win rate > 60% on closed token positions
- Minimum 20 completed trades in measurement window
- Measurement window: all-time (track KOL wallets historically per owner preference)
- Includes: all tokens traded, not token-specific
- Confidence: scales with trade count (20 trades → 0.65, 100 trades → 0.85, 500+ → 0.95)

**SNIPER** (Q26)
- Buy was among the first significant transactions of a new pool/launch
- Amount is not near-zero (ghost tx filter: ≥ 0.5 SOL equivalent minimum)
- `[PLAN]` Thresholds: within first 100 transactions of pool creation OR within first 60 seconds
- Reference Axiom's classification data where available for cross-validation
- Confidence: 0.85 (timing is deterministic, but "significance" requires heuristic)

**INSIDER** (Q28 — combination required, context-sensitive)
- SUSPECTED: any 1 signal (funded by deployer OR bought within first 10 blocks OR holds undisclosed token)
- PROBABLE: any 2 of the above signals
- CONFIRMED: not achievable via heuristics — requires human review/known wallet submission
- Use discretion: a deployer funding 10 wallets that all snipe the same token = stronger signal than a single funding event

**DEPLOYER**
- Has invoked Token Program mint creation, OR
- Has deployed a BPF/SBPF program
- Deterministic — confidence 1.0

**BOT** (Q29)
- Signal A: >5 transactions per minute sustained over 10+ minutes (tx frequency)
- Signal B: Transaction timing variance < 200ms across 20+ sequential transactions
- Signal C: Same program interactions in >80% of transactions over 24h window
- Signal D: Zero failed transactions over 50+ transactions (too clean)
- Signal E: Transaction source identified as known MEV/bot platform
- Confidence: 0.70 (behavioral, can be wrong for legitimate automation)
- Note: Transaction source tracking (Solscan data, source program) aids this classification per owner feedback

**BUNDLER**
- Appears in Jito bundle transactions with launch sniping patterns
- Co-buys same token with 2+ other addresses in same bundle transaction
- Confidence: 0.80

**WASH TRADER**
- Sells token to an address that sells back within 5 minutes
- Buy/sell loop completes ≥ 3 times with same or related addresses
- Net economic gain < 0.5% after fees (no profit motive)
- Confidence: 0.70

**LP PROVIDER**
- Interacts with AMM pool creation instructions
- Holds LP token mints
- Deterministic — confidence 0.90+

**EXCHANGE** / **PROTOCOL**
- Matches Solana FM or internal entity labels database
- OR receives from/sends to >1,000 unique addresses per day
- Confidence: 0.85 from database match, 0.70 from hub pattern

**KNOWN KOL / KNOWN FIGURE**
- Present in known_wallets database with appropriate category
- Twitter/Telegram handle linked
- Confidence: 1.0 (admin-approved)

### 6.2 Transaction Source Platform Detection

Display transaction source logos in all transaction lists. Detection logic:

| Platform | Detection Method |
|---|---|
| Axiom | Source program address match |
| Phantom | Wallet app identification from tx metadata |
| Jupiter | Jupiter Aggregator program address |
| Raydium | Raydium AMM/CLMM program address |
| Orca | Orca Whirlpool program address |
| Pump.fun | Pump.fun program address |
| Coinbase | Known CEX deposit address match |
| Jito | Jito tip program in transaction |
| Meteora | Meteora program address |
| Unknown | Default fallback |

Maintain a `source_programs.json` lookup table. Update regularly.

## 7. Side Wallet Detection

### 7.1 Signal Weights (Q30 — all signals confirmed, use discretion and context)

| Signal | Base Weight |
|---|---|
| Direct SOL transfer to/from a known labeled wallet | 0.40 |
| Same funding source (same originator funded both) | 0.35 |
| Appeared in same Jito bundle | 0.35 |
| Co-sniped same token in same block window (±5 blocks) | 0.30 |
| Cross-chain origination (same CEX withdrawal → multiple Solana wallets) | 0.30 |
| Consistent co-timing (transact within 5 min of each other, 5+ times) | 0.25 |
| Shared unusual token holdings (5+ same obscure tokens) | 0.20 |

**Confidence = min(weighted sum of triggered signals, 1.0)**

Context adjustments:
- If both wallets are labeled known entities: confidence capped at 0.4 (unlikely to be same entity)
- If one is an exchange: automatically excluded from side wallet detection
- Multiple co-snipes of same token across multiple launches: weight multiplied by occurrence count

### 7.2 Display and Dispute (Q31, Q32, Q33)

- **Display:** Automatically listed under wallet profile above confidence threshold of 0.50 (no toggle needed — shown by default as "Potential Side Wallets")
- **Shown as:** Confidence % + list of triggered signals ("Direct SOL transfer · Co-sniped 3 tokens")
- **AI explanation:** When queried via Bloodhound AI, the AI explains connections, confidence, and reasoning in natural language
- **Dispute system (Q33):** Users can flag a side wallet relationship as incorrect via a "Dispute" button. This goes into a review queue (same admin panel as wallet submissions). Dev makes final call. Community disputes affect confidence score ±0.05 per unique disputer.
- **Submission system (Q33):** Users can submit a suspected wallet identity via a form — address, suspected owner, evidence. Goes into the same admin review queue.

## 8. Relationship Classification

### 8.1 Relationship Types (Q34 — all confirmed)

| Relationship | Detection |
|---|---|
| "Funded by" | Direct SOL transfer, within first 5 transactions of receiving wallet |
| "Frequently transfers to" | ≥ 3 direct transfers over any time period |
| "Co-sniper" | Bought same launch, same block window |
| "Cluster member" | Louvain community detection groups them |
| "Same bundle" | Appeared in same Jito bundle |
| "Deployer → Funded" | Deployer wallet (known) funded this address |
| "LP partner" | Both provided liquidity to same pool |
| "Exchange connection" | Both connected to same CEX deposit address |

### 8.2 Graph Traversal (Q35)

- **Default depth: 2 hops** (wallet + direct connections + their connections) — confirmed by owner Q56
- User can expand by clicking nodes to reveal further connections
- Explicitly selectable depth: 1 / 2 / 3 / 4 / 5
- `[PLAN]` Max computed: 5 hops. Beyond 3 hops, warn user "graph may be very large."

### 8.3 Minimum Interaction Threshold (Q36)

`[PLAN]`
- SOL transfer: ≥ 0.1 SOL to qualify as a connection
- Token transfer: ≥ $1 USD equivalent at time of transfer
- Labeled relationships (known wallet, deployer, bundle): always shown regardless of size

### 8.4 Time Decay (Q37 — confirmed, connection age taken into account)

- **Active:** last interaction < 30 days → shown with full opacity, "Active" label
- **Historical:** last interaction 30–365 days → shown at 60% opacity, "Historical" label
- **Dormant:** last interaction > 365 days → hidden by default, toggle to show

## 9. Bloodhound AI System

### 9.1 Feature Name

The AI query interface is the **Bloodhound AI** — it IS the product's AI feature. The user-facing name in nav and UI is "Bloodhound AI." It is NOT called "Ask the Hive" (that was a placeholder in planning docs).

### 9.2 Agentic Capabilities (Q90 — #1 thing to nail)

Bloodhound AI can take actions in the site on the user's behalf. Action types:

| Action | Trigger phrase example |
|---|---|
| Save wallet to tracked list | "save this wallet" / "track dev_wallet" |
| Set an alert | "alert me when poop buys anything" |
| Open graph view | "show me the graph for punk" |
| Run search | "look up this address" |
| Add wallet label | "call this wallet 'insider1'" |
| Export data | "give me a CSV of these transfers" |

These actions are returned in the AI response as structured `actions[]` objects. The frontend executes them automatically and confirms to the user: "Done — I've added dev_wallet to your tracked list."

### 9.3 NL Query Pipeline

```
User query
    │
    ▼
Intent Classifier (claude-haiku-4-5-20251001)
    │  → classify into:
    │    relationship_query | wallet_summary | fund_trace | token_query |
    │    agentic_action | unknown
    │
    ▼
Context Injector
    │  → inject user's tracked wallet labels (name → address map)
    │  → resolve any labels/handles in query to actual addresses
    │  → inject prior session queries (last 10 as context)
    │
    ▼
Tool Selector (claude-sonnet-4-6 with tool_use)
    │  → picks 1-5 tools to call based on intent
    │
    ▼
Tool Executor (FastAPI dispatches to ClickHouse / Supabase / Graph engine)
    │  → executes queries, caches results in Redis (5min TTL for price data, 1hr for historical)
    │
    ▼
Result Formatter (claude-sonnet-4-6)
    │  → formats into: {answer, numbers[], evidence[], confidence, viz_type, actions[]}
    │
    ▼
Response to Frontend
```

**Agentic loop:** Max 5 tool call iterations. Claude calls tools until `stop_reason == "end_turn"`. If max iterations reached without answer, return partial result with `[SUSPECTED]` confidence.

### 9.4 AI Tool Definitions (Pydantic)

```python
class CheckTransfers(BaseModel):
    """Check if wallet A has sent to wallet B. Returns amounts, dates, tx count."""
    from_address: str
    to_address: str
    time_from: Optional[datetime] = None
    time_to: Optional[datetime] = None
    min_amount_sol: float = 0.1

class TraceFunding(BaseModel):
    """Trace the original funding source of a wallet (first SOL received + hop trace)."""
    address: str
    max_hops: int = 3

class GetWalletSummary(BaseModel):
    """Get behavioral summary, stats, and classification for a wallet."""
    address: str
    days_back: int = 90

class GetRelationships(BaseModel):
    """Get relationship graph data for a wallet."""
    address: str
    depth: int = 2
    relationship_types: Optional[List[str]] = None

class RunClickHouseQuery(BaseModel):
    """Execute a parameterized ClickHouse query for custom analytics."""
    query_template: str      # pre-approved template name, not raw SQL
    parameters: Dict[str, Any]

class TakeAction(BaseModel):
    """Take an agentic action in the app on behalf of the user."""
    action_type: str         # 'track_wallet' | 'set_alert' | 'add_label' | 'open_graph'
    parameters: Dict[str, Any]
```

### 9.5 AI Rules (Q39 — confirmed)

**NEVER:**
- Link wallet addresses to real-world identities (only use labels from known_wallets DB)
- Make accusations about illegal activity (use "suspected," "may indicate," "possible")
- Speculate on future price movements
- Fabricate transaction evidence — every claim must link to a real tx signature
- Answer confidently about wallets with zero on-chain history

**Confidence tiers (Q38):**
- `CONFIRMED` — Direct on-chain proof, returned as evidence links
- `PROBABLE` — Strong multi-signal pattern, >1 supporting signal
- `SUSPECTED` — Weak or single-signal inference
- `UNKNOWN` — Insufficient data

**When data is absent (Q40):**
- Zero history → "This address has no recorded on-chain activity. [UNKNOWN]"
- Partial data → Attempt inference, clearly flag as `[SUSPECTED]`, offer to clarify
- Ambiguous query → Ask user to clarify the intent

**Multi-turn memory (Q41):**
- User's tracked wallet labels always injected into context at session start
- Last 10 queries kept in session context (cleared on page refresh for free users)
- Pro users: session context persists via Supabase (cross-session memory)

---

## 10. Real-Time System

### 10.1 Helius Webhook Pipeline

Register webhooks for:
- All transactions by any wallet in any user's tracked list (updated dynamically)
- Token Program: new mint creation events (Signals module)
- Pump.fun program: new launch events (Signals + launch intel)
- Jito bundle program: bundle detection

**Webhook flow:**
1. Helius delivers parsed event payload to FastAPI webhook endpoint
2. Validate webhook signature
3. Write to ClickHouse (transfers, transactions, token_trades tables) — async, non-blocking
4. Evaluate alert rules for all users tracking involved wallet addresses
5. Trigger notifications via Ably for matching alerts
6. Publish to relevant Ably channels (user-specific + global signals channel)

### 10.2 Frontend Real-Time

- **Global signals feed:** Ably public channel, all users subscribed
- **Tracked wallet feed:** Ably per-user channel (user_id based)
- **Graph live updates:** WebSocket per graph session
- **Landing page live feed:** Ably public channel — KOL movements, large swaps, notable events

## 11. Twitter/X Integration

**Purpose:** Link wallets to @handles, surface KOL tweet activity alongside wallet data.

**Implementation:**
1. known_wallets entries can have a `twitter_handle` field (set by admin on approval)
2. When a wallet has a linked handle: fetch recent tweets mentioning tokens (Twitter API v2 search)
3. Cache in Redis (1hr TTL)
4. Surface on wallet profile page and in Bloodhound AI context

**On wallet profile:** Show `@handle` chip that links to their Twitter profile. Below this, show their last 3 tweets mentioning any Solana token (collapsible section: "Recent Twitter Activity")

**For KOL tracking:** When a tracked wallet (with linked handle) tweets about a token, this can trigger a Signal event.

**`[PLAN]`** API plan: Start with Twitter API v2 Free tier (1M tweets/mo read). Upgrade to Basic ($100/mo) if volume demands it. Cache everything aggressively.

## 15. Multi-Chain Architecture (Q84)

Solana-only now. Architecture must not require a rewrite to add chains later.

- All DB tables include a `chain` column defaulting to `'solana'`
- All API endpoints include `chain` in response objects
- Frontend: chain selector in nav (disabled/hidden for now, enabled when adding EVM chains)
- Classification engine: chain-aware (whale thresholds may differ per chain)

## 16. Data Retention (Q88)

`[PLAN]` All transaction history is stored in ClickHouse indefinitely (storage is cheap on ClickHouse). The UI gates access:
- Anonymous + Free: last 90 days visible
- Pro: full history visible
- This means we always have the data — we just choose what to show based on tier
